allow: PowerShell($chars = Select-String -Path "src\\data\\characters.ts" -Pattern "^\\s+id: '" | Measure-Object; Write-Output "character defs: $\($chars.Count\)"; Get-ChildItem src\\assets -Directory | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\): $\(\(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -File | Where-Object Name -notmatch 'README'\).Count\) files" })

PowerShell(Get-Content "src\\data\\franchises.ts" -Encoding utf8 | Select-Object -First 40; Write-Output "=== franchise usage ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\data\\characters.ts" -Pattern "franchise: '\([a-z-]+\)'" -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches } | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\): $\($_.Count\)" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== run.ts rollMysteryItem ==="; Get-Content "src\\sim\\run.ts" -Encoding utf8 | Select-Object -Skip 240 -First 60; Write-Output "=== events.ts choice/act ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\sim\\events.ts" -Pattern "choice|act|slot|item" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== ShopScene icon usage ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\ui\\screens\\ShopScene.ts" -Pattern "icon|Text|Sprite" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" } | Select-Object -First 14; Write-Output "=== BattleScene choice bar ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\ui\\screens\\BattleScene.ts" -Pattern "choice|options|actionBar|slot" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" } | Select-Object -First 25; Write-Output "=== CharacterCard held item ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\ui\\components\\CharacterCard.ts" -Pattern "heldItem|getShopItem|item" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" })

PowerShell(Get-Content "src\\app\\layout.ts" -Encoding utf8; Write-Output "=== Game layout usage ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\app\\Game.ts" -Pattern "layout|viewportDesign|frame" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" } | Select-Object -First 15)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== ShopScene imports/head ==="; Get-Content "src\\ui\\screens\\ShopScene.ts" -Encoding utf8 -TotalCount 16; Write-Output "=== drawBag icon usage ==="; Select-String -Path "src\\ui\\screens\\ShopScene.ts" -Pattern "item.icon|held.icon|\\.icon" | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" })
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -Confirm:$false; "killed $_" })
